mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is negative: lower FEDFUNDS implies positive returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no negative correlation with 20-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE>5.0 AND PAYEMS growth <0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25% over 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% over 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A higher GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate shows no positive correlation with 20-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as market participants react quickly to monetary policy signals.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no negative correlation with 5-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter) as the economic momentum supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate shows no positive correlation with 60-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.
